job.style: a short story with Indian characters in everyday life

response.passage: Last Sunday, Rohan and his younger sister Meera visited the City Zoo with their grandfather. They reached the main gate at 9:00 AM, just as the ticket counter opened. The zoo was crowded because the annual Wildlife Festival was being held that week. Rohan was excited to see the Bengal tigers, but he was disappointed to find the tiger enclosure empty. A zookeeper explained that the tigers were moved to the medical wing for their routine check-up. Near the pond, Meera spotted 12 flamingos standing on one leg. She asked why they did that, and their grandfather explained that flamingos stand on one leg to conserve body heat. By 2:00 PM, the children were exhausted from walking under the hot sun. They decided to head home, promising to return next month to see the tigers. As they walked to the bus stop, they saw a large poster of Rani Lakshmibai at the nearby museum, reminding them of their history project. It had been a long but memorable day for the siblings.
response.summary: Rohan and Meera visited the City Zoo with their grandfather on a busy Sunday. They learned why flamingos stand on one leg and enjoyed their day despite missing the tigers.
